changes: Real GLM Flash/Pro, DSpark formal Flash/Pro and Kimi component programs use existing product ProgramIo for cold input handles, prepared output ownership/bytes, binding and retain.

A test-local stable ColdProgram replaces the original compiled graph holder; the original CompiledGraph, Invocation, caller LeasePool, Commands replay, counters, Head/state, resident supply and true retirement remain authoritative.

External resident bank/map port search, input masks and WeightBinding order are prepared once per actual phase. No per-execution output byte arithmetic or runtime port-index search remains in the shared runner.

Synchronous consumers keep the original reset-only success cleanup. An initially added redundant unbind and unnecessary product overload were removed before final regression; no new binding-release requirement or doubled cleanup scan.

Cold plans reject duplicate/out-of-range ports, missing binder and foreign program before modifying an original prepared Invocation. Original pool refusal, native checked failure, retained-source refusal and unknown exception type retain their old recovery contracts.

Real first-compression DSpark history exposed an existing CUDA indexer bug. Exact HEAD consumer/runner/native-header A/B with the same SDK reproduced identical incorrect scores, excluding the IO migration as cause.

Indexer BF16 head reduction used a strided Sum with zero input_strides, repeating the first dot product. Set physical key/token/head byte strides; shared packed/paged/dense tile math, rounding stages and buffers remain unchanged.

New exact finite zero-first-head T2/L3 regression fails against old provider object and passes against the single refreshed provider CXX object. Existing three indexer tests also pass; no native kernel recompile.
preserved_failures: GLM Flash initial strict /W4 /WX compile failed C4456: new phase boundary shadowed outer cold ResidentBoundary. Renamed router; no warning suppression.
GLM early initial strict compile failed C4456: new plane loop index shadowed existing bank lambda. Renamed plane; no warning suppression.
Current and exact HEAD baseline DSpark early-history CUDA consumers both fail the same independent index-score bounds at position3/layers40 and42 before any resident-bank binding.
New indexer regression with old provider returns zero for visible scores instead of 0.99609375, 3.03125 and 4.5625; independent oracle and masks unchanged.

reproduction.details: verification.json, plan.json, build.py and original process/source/dependency receipts in evidence ZIP

limitations: These are finite real source-role/state consumers, not whole GLM/DeepSeek/Kimi engines or large-model task-quality certification. Their original initial history and upstream fixtures remain.

DSpark original_state standalone TU was compile-only in this slice. Shared Native/Routed helpers execute in the selected Pro/formal Flash and early-history consumers; this does not certify every standalone runtime variant.
No new throughput, allocation-peak, kernel-count or cross-platform claim. Latest full performance window remains 2026-10-28.
Cross-pump continuation and complete multi-model execution orchestration remain unfinished; ProgramIo reuse does not claim the whole common engine is complete.
